title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging for data residency
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enforces KMS region pinning during RBAC v2 policy evaluation and enhances audit logs to include data residency metadata. No external API changes; rollout gated behind feature flag.
description:
Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require strong guarantees that keys and encrypted data remain in allowed regions. RBAC v2 previously allowed policy bindings to reference KMS keys without strict region checks; combined with insufficient audit metadata this made compliance reviews manual and error-prone. This PR enforces KMS region pinning in the RBAC v2 evaluation path and augments audit logs with residency fields to make automated attestation possible.

What this changes: enforces that any RBAC v2 policy which references a KMS key must either (a) pin an allowed region set that includes the request region or (b) reference a key marked as globally available via org policy. When enforcement is enabled (feature flag: rbac_v2.kms_region_enforce=true) requests that violate region pinning are denied with a clear error code (403 KMS_REGION_PIN_VIOLATION). Audit logs now include residency metadata: kms_key_id, kms_key_region, evaluated_policy_id, enforcement_result, and policy_origin. A lightweight residency index was added to the audit store to speed queries.

Checklist: [x] Policy evaluator changes and unit tests; [x] Audit log schema + migration; [x] Integration tests covering allowed/denied flows; [x] Terraform IAM + KMS residency infra snippets; [x] Docs and migration guide; [x] Security review completed by SEC-210.

Compatibility and rollout: The feature is behind a feature flag and defaults to audit-only mode to avoid customer impact. Gradual rollout plan: 1) enable audit-only mode org-by-org for two weeks; 2) enable enforcement for low-risk orgs with alerting; 3) full enforcement after 30 days or earlier if no regressions. Migration steps are documented in docs/security/rbac-v2-kms-region-pinning.md.

Testing: Added unit tests for policy evaluator, integration tests exercising audit ingestion and query paths, and an e2e scenario that simulates a cross-region key reference. CI ran the full suite (build, unit, integration, lint). Performance: policy checks add a negligible CPU cost (~<0.5ms median per evaluation) and the residency index keeps audit query latency stable under load.

Security review notes: Reviewed by SEC-210; threat model updated to include KMS impersonation scenarios and audit tampering mitigations. KMS metadata is pulled using existing authenticated control-plane calls; no new key material flows through logs. Audit log entries are HMAC-signed in storage for tamper-evidence.

Documentation: Added docs/security/rbac-v2-kms-region-pinning.md with migration steps and example Linear tasks. Also updated the public RBAC v2 spec to include residency semantics.

Rollout checklist for SRE/Customer Success: feature flag toggles, monitor alerts (failed-enforcement-rate, audit-ingest-errors), migration support playbook, and a rollback plan (disable enforcement flag to return to audit-only behavior).

Related: ENG-4321 (RBAC v2 enforcement work), SEC-210 (security review), SUP-1421 (customer report with repro).
